client.note: All three rendered clients install and activate the exact approved gear-inclusive Friend Edition loadout. Open Source Saddlery, Weaponry, and Armory are byte-exact content modules with no executable submodules. RebellionsAndDemographics v3.0.1 is active through the pinned 1.4.8 host-authoritative lifecycle adapter; clients receive its canonical readiness receipt and never run upstream campaign behaviors. RBM is retired after its native campaign-initialization crash. The optional TaleWorlds BirthAndDeath module stays disabled.

server.canonicalHarmonyPolicy: Activate the pinned Bannerlord.Harmony v2.4.2.248 Workshop module before Native and Coop. Its Win64 0Harmony and wrapper hashes are proven by the selected nightly's live dedicated-server topology. Coop's embedded 0Harmony is excluded, and no bootstrap is provided or implied.
server.note: Production launch activates the approved gear-inclusive Friend Edition order including RebellionsAndDemographics v3.0.1. Coop replaces the upstream peer-local lifecycle with a pinned host-authoritative adapter and canonical client readiness receipt.
